story.ch00.title: The Dry Bell
story.ch00.summary: A dry bell interrupts the morning. With the senior cultivators warning the lower valley, the apprentice accepts the local repair route.
story.ch00.s01.title: Dust at Daybreak
story.ch00.s01.line_01: There should be water on the bell's lip. Last week it filled this basin.
story.ch00.s01.line_02: It measures what the vein can spare. This morning the return is dry. Leave the rope alone.
story.ch00.s01.line_04: The well still has water. Something has stopped returning through the channels. Those are different problems.
story.ch00.s01.line_05: Where is Elder Yun? His door has been shut for days.
story.ch00.s01.line_06: He left six days ago to warn the villages below. The senior cultivators went with him. He left you a route, and me a list of repairs longer than my arm.
story.ch00.s01.objective: Ring the courtyard bell and speak to Keeper Lan.
story.ch00.s01.journal: The bell produced dust. Lan says the return channels have failed, although the well still has water. Elder Yun left six days ago to warn the lower valley and left local repair instructions.
story.ch00.s01.choice_LOOK: I will look at the channels before touching them.
story.ch00.s01.response_LOOK: Good. A clean break and a blocked channel can look alike from here.
story.ch00.s01.choice_HELP: Tell me what will help the people below.
story.ch00.s01.response_HELP: Find the blockage first. Promising them rain will not put water in a bucket.
story.ch00.s02.title: Hands Before Power
story.ch00.s02.line_01: You carried supply poles before you carried a sword. Keep that balance. The blade is lighter; your feet still do the work.
story.ch00.s02.line_02: And if the channel spits at me?
story.ch00.s02.line_03: Watch what moves before the strike. Roots lift the paving. Lightning draws its line. Neither cares how brave you feel.
story.ch00.s02.line_04: The jade arc carries your edge farther. Cast once, then watch your breath return. Empty lungs make a poor sword arm.
story.ch00.s02.line_05: The ward bends the light around my wrist.
story.ch00.s02.line_06: It will take a blow, not a whole mountain. Learn its limit here, where a mistake costs you a bruise.
story.ch00.s02.objective: Complete sword, dodge, technique, and recovery practice.
story.ch00.s02.journal: Lan taught me to read visible warnings and recover between casts. Jade Sword Arc and Flowing Ward are ready for the guided route.
story.ch00.s02.prompt_sword: Strike the training target with a sword combo.
story.ch00.s02.prompt_dodge: Wait for the ground outline, then dodge outside it.
story.ch00.s02.prompt_cast: Cast Jade Sword Arc, then use Flowing Ward. Recover at the shrine when the lane is clear.
story.ch00.s02.retry: Sit a moment. The target will still be here when you stand.
story.ch00.s03.title: A Route Written Six Days Ago
story.ch00.s03.line_01: Elder Yun — route instructions. Written six days before the dry bell.
story.ch00.s03.line_02: I am taking the senior cultivators downriver to warn the households along the low banks. You know these paths from the supply runs. That is why I ask you to inspect them.
story.ch00.s03.line_03: Begin at Bamboo Hollow, where the intake spreads its load through the roots. Test the short route before attempting the anchor chamber. Return if the paving shakes beneath your feet.
story.ch00.s03.line_04: After the bamboo intake, Ashen Peak must release the heat. Do not work both anchors before you have established your Foundation. Lan has the old access tools.
story.ch00.s03.line_05: He wrote this before the bell failed. He expected trouble.
story.ch00.s03.line_06: He expected a bad season. I cannot tell you what he measured downriver. Bring me your own measurements.
story.ch00.s03.objective: Read Yun’s dated route instructions at the shrine.
story.ch00.s03.journal: Yun’s letter predates the dry bell. It orders a short Bamboo test, then the intake repair; Ashen Peak must wait until Foundation Establishment. His party is warning downstream households.
story.ch00.s03.sealed_packet: Archive instructions. The cord is tied through the reader’s seal; opening requires a restored archive reader.
story.ch00.s04.title: The Unlatched Gate
story.ch00.s04.line_01: This iron key turns inspection shutters. It is not a charm. If it sticks, stop before you break the stem.
story.ch00.s04.line_02: Someone has left reed tags on the gate.
story.ch00.s04.line_03: Supply markers. People used this path before the sanctuary put a name over it. Leave the latch open behind you.
story.ch00.s04.line_05: There is a return shrine on the short route. Test it, take a reading, come home. We can close a path after we know who needs it.
story.ch00.s04.objective: Enter the guided Bamboo route through the open gate.
story.ch00.s04.journal: Lan gave me the inspection key and kept the gate unlatched for other travelers. The short route has a safe return shrine.
story.ch00.s04.enter: Begin the guided route. Equipment can be changed again at the entrance.
